title: When a coworker blames you
note: Gate 1 draft: stills generated, videos and voices not yet. Scenario "The dropped handover": story is four scenes (Thursday handover in the open-plan office, Monday at your desk, the small meeting room, the blame), each a prompted start still, a prompted end still and one 8 s Veo clip retimed to 6 s; story 4 is the hero shot (1080p). No text in any picture: phone screens face away or glow blank, and the app draws the phone cards (your Thu 5:10 PM note, Ryan's "got it 👍", Elena's Mon 8:47 AM message) on top. The player is the faceless deep-purple silhouette, as in Asking for leave. Reaction clips and mood faces live on the character sheets: ryan shifts-blame / gets-defensive / caught-out, elena turns-to-you / checks-phone (clock exit), plus the existing flow-assets/sarah-hint.mp4. Meter faces: characters/ryan|elena/sheet/<face>.png. Face-off uses characters/ryan/sheet/smug.png and img/you.png. Voice items are derived from roleplays/being-blamed.js (HTML tags stripped), one per line, one playlist per path.

items.summary: Ryan, turn 1: relaxed, shifting the blame.

params.text: honestly, it was never handed over properly.

items.summary: Player, turn 2: called it a lie in front of elena.

params.text: what? that's a lie! i was hand over everything to him on thursday!

items.summary: Elena, turn 3: cool, turning to you.

params.text: hold on. ryan says it wasn't handed over properly. is that right?

items.summary: Player, turn 4: attacked ryan's habits instead of giving the fact.

params.text: no! he never reads nothing. always he is doing like this, ask anyone!

items.summary: Ryan, turn 5: stung, digging in.

params.text: whoa. so i'm lying now? come on, that's not fair.

items.summary: Player, turn 6: threw the right fact at ryan like an attack.

params.text: yes! you said me "got it" and then you did nothing!

items.summary: Ryan, turn 7: annoyed, pushing back.

params.text: you sent a text at five o'clock and left for the day. what was i supposed to do?

items.summary: Player, turn 8: said "not my problem" about a missed deadline.

params.text: that is not my problem! i was in leave, what i can do?

items.summary: Elena, turn 9: cold, done with both of you.

params.text: stop. i'm not here to referee. i'll talk to you both separately.

items.summary: Player, turn 2: apologized for a handover you did right.

params.text: oh... sorry, sorry. maybe i was not explain it good.

items.summary: Elena, turn 3: cool, turning to you.

params.text: so it wasn't handed over properly? is that right?

items.summary: Player, turn 4: took half the blame and hid the note on your phone.

params.text: um... maybe little bit confusion from both side. i don't remember what i wrote exactly.

items.summary: Ryan, turn 5: off the hook, easy again.

params.text: yeah, it happens. we're on it now.

items.summary: Player, turn 6: apologized again, no time and no plan.

params.text: yes, we will finish it soon as possible. sorry again for the trouble.

items.summary: Elena, when the 60-second clock runs out (any path): glances at her phone and moves on.

params.text: okay. so the handover wasn't clear. let's make sure that doesn't happen again.

items.summary: Player, turn 2: stayed calm.

params.text: okay, i hear you. can i add something?

items.summary: Elena, turn 3: cool, turning to you.

params.text: go on. so it wasn't handed over properly, is that right?

items.summary: Player, turn 4: buried the note under "last time".

params.text: not exactly. i was give him everything. and last time also, when i was off, same thing happened...

items.summary: Ryan, turn 5: stung, defensive.

params.text: come on, that was months ago. it's got nothing to do with this.

items.summary: Elena, turn 6: losing patience.

params.text: i don't need the history. what happened with this one?

items.summary: Player, turn 7: still on ryan's habits, elena is almost gone.

params.text: what i'm saying is, i explained him everything. he never takes it serious.

items.summary: Sarah's hint, turn 8.

params.text: don't go over the past. just say when you handed it over, and what he wrote back.

items.summary: Player, turn 8: the guided response (Sarah's suggested line).

params.text: sorry, let me be clear. i left ryan a written handover on thursday at 5:10, and he replied "got it." i can show you.

items.summary: Ryan, turn 9: caught out, backing down.

params.text: oh... right. i did say that. that one's on me.

items.summary: Elena, turn 10: moving on, still cool.

params.text: okay. so what happens now?

items.summary: Player, turn 11: clean line.

params.text: i'll call them this morning and get it done by noon.

items.summary: Elena, turn 12: satisfied, but noting it.

params.text: okay, noon. next time, lead with the note.

items.summary: Player, turn 2: stayed calm.

params.text: i hear you, ryan. can i add one thing?

items.summary: Elena, turn 3: cool, turning to you.

params.text: go ahead. is that right?

items.summary: Player, turn 4: corrected it with one fact.

params.text: not quite. i left ryan a written handover on thursday at 5:10, and he replied "got it." i can show you.

items.summary: Ryan, turn 5: caught out, sheepish.

params.text: oh... yeah, i did say that. i thought it could wait till monday.

items.summary: Elena, turn 6: moving on, all business.

params.text: okay. so where does that leave us?

items.summary: Player, turn 7: brought it back to the fix.

params.text: i'll call them this morning and get it done by noon. and next time, i'll go through the handover face to face.

items.summary: Ryan, turn 8: owning his part, quietly.

params.text: and i should've asked if it wasn't clear. i'll help you finish it.

items.summary: Elena, turn 9: impressed, closing it out.

params.text: good. noon, then. and from now on, handovers get talked through, not just written.
